# typeassert: switch case with multiple values, same assertion (joinTypeAssert ok)
# and case with incompatible assertions (joinTypeAssert nil)
typeassert {
	var x I
	x.M() == 1 -> x.(m1)
	x.M() == 2 -> x.(m2)
}
-- x.go --
package p

type I interface{ M() int }
type m1 int
type m2 int

func (m1) M() int { return 1 }
func (m2) M() int { return 2 }

func f(x I) {
	// case with incompatible assertions - no rewrite
	{
		switch x.M() {
		case 1, 2:
			_ = x
		}
	}
}
